personal.preferred_title: AWS Data Engineer | Glue, Redshift, SQL, Dimensional Modeling & ETL

summary: Senior AWS Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across AWS data platforms, Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, AWS Glue, Redshift, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, SQL performance tuning, data quality, and production reporting systems. Strong background building scalable data workflows, curated reporting layers, validation checks, performance-oriented schemas, and stakeholder-facing analytics for regulated enterprise environments. Best aligned to AWS data engineering roles requiring Glue, Redshift, advanced SQL, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, data quality, governance, and reliable delivery; dbt, AWS CDK, Jinja, CodePipeline/CodeCommit, MWAA, Step Functions, Lambda, and CDC are positioned as adjacent or active-learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

Refactored manual and legacy reporting workflows into repeatable ETL processes with documented extraction logic, validation checkpoints, transformation rules, and operational support steps.
Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware access.
Partnered with infrastructure, analytics, application, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready data products, dashboards, and support documentation.
